insight: AWS's serverless runtime for production agents; reached general availability in October 2025 and runs agents from any framework.
name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tagline: Serverless runtime and services for deploying AI agents in production.
description: AWS's enterprise platform for taking AI agents from prototype to production. A secure, serverless Runtime hosts agents built with any framework (Strands, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) and any model, alongside modular services for Memory, Identity, Gateway (turning APIs/Lambdas into MCP tools), a Code Interpreter, Browser tool, and Observability.

modelSupport.notes: Framework- and model-agnostic; runs agents built on any framework with any model.

edge: Framework- and model-agnostic managed runtime — deploy agents built in Strands, LangGraph, or CrewAI with built-in identity, memory, and tools.
pros: Serverless runtime for any agent framework
Modular memory, identity, gateway, browser, code tools
